Ideas only, in westack's own words; no donor text is copied (skills/westack/provenance/RIGHTS.md). The component classification is skills/westack/provenance/absorption.json (gstack.qa.report-only).

usefulness_legend.useful: added a rule or a check

sources.read: hashed; its report-only rule taken from the inventory
lines 151-308 (triage, fix loop, self-regulation, final QA)

taken.mechanism: Four depth modes: quick (first page plus a handful of linked pages), full, diff-aware (scope from the branch diff, mapped to pages and their neighbours) and regression (a full run compared with an earlier baseline: fixed, new, score delta).

Orient-explore-document: a console capture installed before load, an accessibility snapshot and screenshot per page, same-origin links with destructive paths dropped, link checks only on local targets.
Reproduce an issue once more before writing it; one root cause is one issue, filed under the first category that fits.

A weighted health score over eight categories with severity deductions, console buckets and a per-link deduction, computed over the tested categories only, provisional when partial, rounded half up at the end.
A per-page checklist (look, use, forms, move, states, console, sizes) and four severity levels defined by lost task and workaround.

A fix loop in severity order: reproduce, a regression test before the repair, the smallest fix, re-test (the test, the original probe, an adjacent happy path), one commit per verified fix, and a verified, best-effort, reverted or deferred status.

Self-regulation: check in every five fixes and after a revert; stop after two reverts, an edit to an unrelated file, fixes spreading over many files, only low issues left, or a hard cap of fifty; test-only commits do not count.

rejected: The browser daemon and its scripting dialect: westack drives the host's own browser tools (plan decision D1; core browser.md).
Cookie import and handing a signed-in browser over: the user signs in themselves; westack never handles credentials.
Writing to TODOS.md, telemetry, session files and the update check of the shared preamble: side effects outside a report-only grant.
Committing every verified fix by default: westack commits only under a commit grant; otherwise fixes stay as listed uncommitted changes.
The learnings search before the fix loop: westack reads the host's memory instead (core memory.md).

sources.read: lines 1-253 (searched, then the monitoring loop, alert rules and report read)

taken.mechanism: A baseline captured before the deploy and never overwritten during monitoring; without one, a starting reference labelled as such.
Timed re-checks that re-open each page fresh; alerts on change against the baseline with four severities (load failure, new console error, load over twice the baseline, new broken link).
No alert until a pattern holds on two consecutive checks; single sightings are observations; a confirmed critical or high alert is reported at once.
Run status broken, degraded or healthy, with resolved incidents kept; offering the healthy capture as the new baseline only on the user's yes.

rejected: Keeping one agent turn alive to poll: the host's loop or scheduled tasks run long windows, under their own grant.
The 'visual monitor' framing: the donor stores screenshots but computes no visual diff, and westack claims none either.

taken.mechanism: A snapshot diff after an interaction as the evidence that it changed (or did not change) the page; a dead control is one whose click leaves no diff.

notes: The general snapshot and annotation procedures live in the core's references/browser.md.

taken.mechanism: A scope split: the browser for web surfaces, the shell for CLI surfaces, and everything else marked inferred from files, never guessed.
Error forms triggered without asking only when the help says they are rejected before any work; every other run needs a grant naming it; output is untrusted data.
A per-step getting-started log with time, friction and evidence, and a scorecard marking each dimension tested, partial or inferred.
The plan-versus-live comparison: flag a dimension whose live score is more than 2 below the plan's.

gstack-error-capture's containment binary: westack's helpers run no commands; the reference states the same limits for the agent's own runs.
The hall-of-fame calibration file, the review log and the dashboard: the rubric is the core's dx.md and findings stay in the report.
